C1468.title: Clorox 2023 Cyberattack Disrupts Production
C1468.summary: In August 2023, Clorox identified unauthorized activity on parts of its IT environment and took systems offline. The company told the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission that the incident caused widespread operational disruption, forced temporary manual order processing, reduced production, and contributed to product shortages. Filings later reported that most manufacturing sites had resumed production, but did not classify the incident as ransomware or confirm compromise of IIoT systems.
